speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic. I see you're experiencing inappropriate behavior, changes in eating habits, and weight gain; to understand the underlying cause, please describe your age and any other medical conditions you have.

speaker: Patient
text: 55-year-old male. The patient has demonstrated inappropriate behavior, including making unfitting comments and attempts to kiss strangers, over the past 6 months. He shows disinterest in family interactions and has developed a particular craving for chocolate pudding and potato chips, resulting in a 10 kg weight gain. The patient also presents as unkempt.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Frontotemporal Dementia (behavioral variant). The combination of profound personality changes, loss of social inhibition, dietary obsessions, and rapid weight gain in a 55-year-old is classic for this condition. I will order an MRI Brain to confirm frontal and temporal lobe atrophy.
